sourceSupport.detail: Non-self targets invoke requireSpaceAdministrator; self-targets skip that guard and the resolved target IDs are passed to Store.DeleteSpaceMember.
Backend independently requires ADMIN for different-target deletion.
Deleting the sole active normal administrator returns ErrLastSpaceAdmin.

rationale: The candidate accurately covers ordinary denial, admin conditionality, self-removal, last-admin protection, actor/resource/effect binding, and the supplied v1 policy. Deployment middleware remains appropriately qualified.
